description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three different models across three evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are ordered from left to right as Recall, Precision, and F1 Score, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the numeric value of these metrics on a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 100 with tick marks at regular intervals of 20, also lacking an explicit axis label or units. The chart features grouped vertical bars, with each category containing a cluster of three bars. According to the legend positioned above the chart, the light blue bars represent a model whose name is obscured by a gray rectangle followed by "(zero-shot)", the dark blue bars represent "TA-SQL (zero-shot)", and the light green bars represent "DIN-SQL (few-shot)". Each bar is visually emphasized with an annotation of its exact numeric value directly above it. In the Recall category, the values are 63.58 (light blue), 71.90 (dark blue), and 72.29 (light green). In the Precision category, the values are 88.89 (light blue), 91.24 (dark blue), and 92.31 (light green). In the F1 Score category, the values are 75.34 (light blue), 80.40 (dark blue), and 81.08 (light green). Within each grouped category, the bar heights consistently increase from left to right. The shortest bar in the chart is the light blue bar in the Recall category at 63.58, while the tallest bar is the light green bar in the Precision category at 92.31.
